    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import get_name, stashedHTML2text, unescape, slugify
import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree

md_text = """[TOC]

# `<test>`
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc"])

# Patch TocTreeprocessor.run to add debug output
original_run = md.treeprocessors['toc'].run

def debug_run(doc):
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
            print(f"Processing {el.tag}")
            name = get_name(el)
            print(f"  get_name: {repr(name)}")
            
            innertext = unescape(stashedHTML2text(name, md))
            print(f"  innertext: {repr(innertext)}")
            
            sl = slugify(innertext, '-')
            print(f"  slugify: {repr(sl)}")
    
    return original_run(doc)

md.treeprocessors['toc'].run = debug_run

html = md.convert(md_text)
print("\nFull HTML:")
print(html)
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
